_comment: C0-10 指南正文英译 · evaluation（2026-10-25）。sections 键 = 节标题中文部分；sources 按索引对齐 frontmatter。官方英文原文引文原样保留。

sections.这一篇讲什么:
**Agent evaluation means quantifying "did the change make it better or worse" with datasets and graders.**
Without it, "optimizing the prompt" is just feel; with it, every change has an auditable ledger.
Evaluation has two battlefields: regression testing before shipping, watching real traffic after.
sections.两个战场:
LangSmith's official docs split evaluation by when it runs.

**Offline evaluation**: run against curated datasets during development,
to compare versions, benchmark, and catch regressions.
**Official one-liner**: "Test before you ship".

**Online evaluation**: score real production interactions in real time,
for safety screening, format validation, quality heuristics.
**Official one-liner**: "Monitor in production".

The two share data: failures seen in production
should become a test case in the dataset.
**LangSmith official text**: "Add failing production traces to your dataset, create targeted evaluators, validate fixes with offline experiments, and redeploy."
This loop is what keeps an evaluation system alive long-term.
sections.四类评分器:
The official docs list four kinds of graders:

| Grader | How it works | Fits |
|---|---|---|
| Human review | People look directly | High-quality gold standard, expensive |
| Code rules | Regex, assertions, deterministic checks | Format, required fields |
| LLM-as-judge | A model scores the output | Subjective quality, at scale |
| Pairwise comparison | Compare two versions on the same question | Either-or iteration |

Code rules are the cheapest and most trustworthy — if it can be computed, don't ask the model.
LLM-as-judge goes on subjective dimensions, but the judge itself errs;
its rubric must be written as reusable instructions, not improvised each time.
sections.一次完整评测长什么样:
The official four steps:

1. Build the dataset: handcrafted cases, historical traces, or synthetic generation.
2. Define graders: pick from the four kinds above.
3. Run experiments: run the whole application over the dataset, configurable repeats and concurrency.
4. Analyze results: compare experiments — benchmarks, unit tests, regressions, backtests.

Evaluating an agent adds one layer over single-turn QA: **the process must be checked too**.
The final answer may be right, but if it called the wrong tools or looped ten times, the cost is completely different.
This is why traces are indispensable in agent evaluation.
sections.评测自己的坑:
1. Dataset drift: cases frozen in three-month-old scenarios while production long ago stopped asking those.
2. Judge bias: LLMs prefer long answers and formats they know;
   LLM-grading-LLM needs periodic alignment against human spot checks.
3. Overfitting the dataset: optimizing for the score, generalization drops — keep a slice never used for tuning.
4. Watching only pass rate: 80% to 85% may all sit on easy cases; look at per-category, per-difficulty breakdowns.

The Reflexion paper points another direction: **use the feedback signal itself as evaluation**.
Its verbal reinforcement turns environment feedback into verbal reflections that are stored —
essentially a passive-feedback-driven, self-executing evaluation loop.
The idea is borrowable, but the reported number (91% pass@1) is a result on a specific benchmark;
transfer to other tasks is not guaranteed.

**Anthropic official text**: "optimizing single LLM calls with retrieval and in-context examples is usually enough" —
first confirm the simple approach has truly hit its ceiling, then build complex evaluation infrastructure.
